apr-06-compound-command.evidence: After the request at 5.3 the developer waits ~15 s for the first response at 20.1, which is a long rambling read-out of a shell command (23 s), and another 10.6 s silence precedes the second garbled permission read-out at 56.8. The relay itself worked, but the pauses and unreadable command recitations make it tiring.
